chapter_title_en: Winds Stir Beyond the Seas; The Scheming Web
chapter_keywords: a record of a mortal's journey to immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 410: The Double Trap – Sublime Sound Sect Discovers They’ve Been Played
chapter_meta_description: The Sublime Sound Sect corners the heretics, but victory turns to shock as both sides realize they’ve fallen into a deadly framing trap. Han Li watches, waiting to bolt.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality – Chapter 410
og_description: The raid on the heretics takes a sharp turn when neither side recognizes the other’s crime. Someone set them up—and the puppet masters are still hidden.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 410: Someone played them all.
twitter_description: The Sublime Sound Sect’s revenge raid goes sideways when the “bandits” turn out to be just as confused as they are. Classic Mortal Stream framing job.

lore_anchors.definition: A corrupted body-transformation technique; in this chapter, it resembles the Black Fiend Sect's variant but lacks the blood-cocoon ritual and internal pill, hinting at a separate lineage or mass-production version.
A reclusive sect of heretical cultivators; claims to rarely interact with outsiders and denies any involvement in the Sublime Sound Sect raid.
The sect seeking revenge; formerly mistaken as 'Wonderful Sound Sect' in some translations; led by Zi Ling and Madam Fan in this expedition.
A tracking spirit insect used to follow the heretics to their island hideout.
The third major cultivation stage, granting greatly increased power and lifespan; late Core Formation is a significant threshold even among elders.
A legendary spiritual wood sought by Han Li; his interest in it motivates his participation in the raid.
A Core Formation elder allied with the Sublime Sound Sect; wields powerful flame-and-thunder magic.
